scope_deferrals.title: Discount semantics inconsistency between Web and API
scope_deferrals.details: OrderService recalculates Total using `Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount)` (treating Discount as a 0..1 fraction), while OrderDetailState.CalculateLineTotal in the Web uses `Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount / 100m)` (treating Discount as a percentage 0..100). The Web's labels read 'Discount %'. The API formula has been in place since commit 3c0a76b (the initial rebuild's 'Session 5 of 6: rebuild app parity in integrated repo'), predating this session set. Session 5's MergeOrderItemsAsync uses the same formula as the existing AddItemAsync/RemoveItemAsync paths for consistency. Fixing this requires a dedicated session: decide canonical semantic, migrate one side, update seeded data if needed, verify no persisted Order.Total values are corrupted. Surfaced by GPT-5.4 verifier Round 1; out of Session 5 scope. Candidate spec slug: `order-discount-semantics-alignment`.
